verdict.rationale: Docs show a very short path from nothing to an installed skill: run `/plugins` to browse a marketplace, install a plugin, start a new session, or use `$skill-installer <name>` for curated skills — all single-command steps with clear CLI examples. Missing for 10: an explicit stated time benchmark (e.g. '<5 min') and independent/hands-on confirmation of onboarding speed beyond docs.
